# Repository instructions

`uniform-array-derive` is a proc-macro crate: `#[derive(UniformArray)]` generates `Index`,
`IndexMut`, `len` and `is_empty`, plus `unsafe` slice conversions behind a cargo feature of
the user's crate. Path-specific rules live in `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md`.

- Crates: `crates/uniform-array-derive` (published; the logic is in `src/expand.rs`, written
  against `proc_macro2` so tests and the fuzz target can call it) and `crates/example`
  (unpublished fixture: `compile_fail` doctests, proptests, Kani proofs). `fuzz/` is a
  separate cargo-fuzz workspace.
- Run checks through the Taskfile: `task ci` mirrors CI. `task lint`, `task test`, `task doc`,
  `task miri`, `task kani` and `task mutants` are the common entry points.
- Every item gets a doc comment, private items included. No `mod.rs` files (use `foo.rs`
  plus `foo/`). No `// ----` separator comments (split the file into modules instead).
- `clippy::pedantic` must stay clean. Suppress only with
  `#[expect(lint, reason = "...")]` on the smallest item. Never `#[allow]` in our own code.
- Both crates are `#![forbid(unsafe_code)]`. The derive *emits* unsafe code into the user's
  crate; that code lives in `quote!` blocks in `expand.rs`.
- Commit subjects use the imperative mood ("Add X", "Fix Y"): no Conventional Commits prefix
  and no past tense. At most 72 characters, then a blank line and a body that explains why.
- Branches: GitHub Flow (`main` plus `feature/<topic>`). Never `fix/`, `chore/`, `deps/` or
  `copilot/`. Before working on a `copilot/*` branch, rename it to `feature/*`.
- CONTRIBUTING.md wins over these instructions where they differ.
- Release PRs are generated by release-plz; do not bump versions by hand.
